headlines.description: The County of Santa Clara Office of the Medical Examiner has identified the 2-year-old girl who died following a major crash in Cupertino last week as Riley Howard of San Jose, authorities said Sunday. The collision occurred Friday afternoon at North Tantau and Pruneridge avenues, according to the Santa Clara County Sheriff’s Office. Deputies from the West Valley Patrol Division responded to the scene at noon, where they found a woman and the toddler suffering from serious injuries. Both victims were transported to a nearby hospital, where the child succumbed to her injuries. The driver of the second vehicle involved sustained minor injuries, was treated at a hospital and was subsequently released. Sheriff’s officials said the man was arrested on suspicion of gross vehicular manslaughter. Investigators are urging anyone who witnessed the crash or possesses information that could aid the investigation to contact the sheriff’s office STARS Team at 408-868-6637.
